item.description:

More than 40 pilot whales have died on a New Zealand beach following a mass stranding that rescuers described as “difficult and distressing.”
The pod of pilot whales was found stranded on the Ngawi coast near the village of Cape Palliser on the southern tip of New Zealand’s North Island just after 8 a.m. local time on Thursday, the country’s Department of Conservation (DOC) said in a statement posted on Facebook that morning.

item.title: At least 31 dead after Russia drops nine bombs on a Ukrainian school building
item.description: Dozens of people were killed when Russia dropped at least nine bombs on a school building in southeastern Ukraine where they had taken shelter.

item.title: Pope Leo’s Latin America trip will take him above 11,000 feet, weeks after lung cancer surgery
item.description: Just over three weeks ago, the most significant visit of Pope Leo’s pontificate looked to be in doubt. The 71-year-old’s lung cancer surgery led some in the Vatican to believe his trip to Latin America would be postponed or its intense schedule adjusted.

item.title: Russell Brand found guilty of rape and sexual assault
item.description: British actor, comedian and media personality Russell Brand was found guilty of rape and sexual assault at a London court on Thursday, according to Reuters news agency.

item.title: A moderate millennial newcomer could decide knife-edge New Zealand election
item.description: New Zealand is set for one of its tightest elections in years, with the incumbent conservative coalition facing an uncertain path to power and polls pointing to a millennial newcomer becoming the kingmaker.

item.title: ‘Like a bolt from the blue:’ Israel’s president shocked by Trump announcing end of aid
item.description: Israeli President Isaac Herzog described President Donald Trump’s Midterm Election Day announcement that he would end US military aid to Israel as “a bolt from the blue.”
